### When You're Not Sure You Belong
Author: Suzie Eller
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/when-you-re-not-sure-you-belong-encouragement-for-today-october-28-2013.html
Passage: Romans 8:16
Points:
- Earthly adoption reflects unconditional love where a child is cherished simply for who they are, not for perfection.
- Believers often worry they are a burden to God due to personal shortcomings and spiritual struggles.
- The Holy Spirit inwardly assures Christians of their true standing as God's adopted children.
- Resting in God as Abba Father removes the dread of rejection and confirms an irrevocable belonging.

### The Witness of the Spirit
Author: Daniel Hyde
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/witness-spirit
Passage: Romans 8:13-16
Points:
- Believers frequently face internal accusations and struggle with feelings of guilt over lingering sin.
- True faith contains biblical assurance, yet that assurance is not always consistently felt.
- The Holy Spirit actively bears witness alongside the believer's own spirit that they are God's children.
- God does not leave Christians to prove their sonship alone, but grants the Spirit to confirm their adoption.
